subject: Ephemeral headroom credit & split billing path for Launchly spike
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen@launchly.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Fields <aaron.fields@launchly.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0000
Subject: Quick help — brief beta spike and short-term headroom request

Evelyn,

We pushed a new recommendations model to 10% of traffic overnight and saw an unexpected token spike — roughly 3x our committed QPS for a 36-hour window. We caught it and rolled back, but the usage landed us above the soft quota and the billing is going to be painful for our finance team.

Can Redwood provide:
- A short-term (72h) headroom allowance to prevent throttling while we stabilize?
- A one-time credit or a blended billing path for the overrun so we can smooth the invoice for this month?

We’re happy to commit to a modest uplift in committed capacity if we can secure a better overrun rate and a small credit for this unexpected launch incident. Procurement is ready to sign a PO for a one-month uplift if terms align.

Attached: latency/usage dump and a brief timeline (launchly_spike_report.csv).

Thanks —
Karen Li
Head of Platform
Launchly
(650) 555-0199

Attachment: launchly_spike_report.csv (CSV, 48KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Li <karen@launchly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 12:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick help — brief beta spike and short-term headroom request

Hi Karen — thanks for the quick context and the attachment, that helps.

We can offer a short-term headroom product we’re calling an "ephemeral buffer":
- 72-hour headroom unlocked immediately upon acceptance (no restart).
- Flat overrun rate during buffer: $0.025/token (20% discount off standard paygo overrun), capped to the amount of uplift you sign in the PO.
- If Launchly converts the uplift into a committed tier within 30 days, we’ll retroactively apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the overrun charges during the buffer (applied to the first invoice after commit).

Operational notes: we’ll enable the buffer from our control plane; no infra changes required on your side. Please confirm PO value and desired uplift (suggested: +40% committed capacity for 30 days) and we’ll provision and route requests under the buffer policy.

I’m attaching a short offer summary (redwood_ephemeral_offer_v1.pdf) with the rate table and acceptance checklist. If Ben/Laura want to propose tweaks to the billing cadence or amortization, tagging them here.

Next steps
- Karen: confirm uplift amount and whether procurement will provide a PO this week.
- Redwood: provision headroom once PO received, invoice per the term sheet, apply credit if commit conversion happens.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
T: +1 415 555 0128

Attachment: redwood_ephemeral_offer_v1.pdf (PDF, 110KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karen Li <karen@launchly.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick help — brief beta spike and short-term headroom request

Looping in finance/ops perspective. Evelyn — offer looks good, a couple of clarifications we should lock before toggling headroom on:
1) Billing lag: Launchly asked for invoice smoothing. We can amortize the ephemeral overrun across the next two invoices rather than one, provided we have a PO with the uplift amount and a committed-conversion clause.
2) Credit trigger: the 50% retro-credit is contingent on converting to commit >= uplift amount for a minimum 30-day period. We should specify the exact metric (average daily tokens over the 30-day window) to avoid ambiguity.
3) Legal/Proc: if Launchly pushes shorter payment terms for the uplift PO, we should require an ACH/credit card on file for the buffer period.

I attached a short billing term sheet that maps the amortization scenarios we discussed. Evelyn, if you want, I can propose the final paragraph language for the PO and acceptance checklist.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: billing_term_sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB)

Thanks, Evelyn and Ben — appreciate the fast turnaround.

We can do the uplift. Procurement approved a PO for a 40% committed uplift for 30 days; they asked if we can:
- Have the overrun amortized across the next two invoices (finance-smoothing).
- Reduce the eligibility window for the retro-credit to conversion within 21 days instead of 30 days (procurement constraint).
- Confirm we can accept the 72-hour buffer starting as soon as Redwood receives the PO; they will try to confirm today.

PO attached: PO_4892.pdf — contact Aaron Fields (aaron.fields@launchly.com) for the procurement signature.

If those three items are acceptable, we’ll sign and you can flip the buffer.

—Karen

Attachment: PO_4892.pdf (PDF, 46KB)

Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick help — brief beta spike and short-term headroom request

Karen — all good, we’re aligned. Summary and next steps below.

Agreed terms (final):
- 72-hour ephemeral buffer enabled on receipt of PO_4892.pdf.
- Overrun pricing during buffer: $0.025/token.
- Amortization: overrun invoiced and smoothed across the next two invoices after the buffer period.
- Retro-credit: 50% of buffer overrun charges, eligible if Launchly converts to a committed tier >= uplift amount within 21 days of the buffer start. Measurement: average daily tokens during the 30-day commitment window must be >= uplift amount.
- Payment: Redwood requires a payment method on file for the buffer period; standard procurement terms otherwise.

Operational steps:
1) Karen/Aaron: confirm the PO numerically matches the uplift line (40% uplift) in the attached offer.
2) Launchly sends PO_4892 to ops@redwood.ai.
3) Redwood will provision buffer within one hour of PO ingestion and confirm activation time.
4) Finance sends the amortized invoice schedule and will apply retro-credit if commit conversion is recorded in the infra.

Links: DocuSign lane for acceptance: https://redwood.app/docusign/DL-4892/accept
Drive reference: https://drive.google.com/launchly-shared/ephemeral-offer-v1

I’ll flip the buffer as soon as ops confirms receipt. Thanks for moving quickly — we’ll keep the channel open for monitoring.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
